+## Review Findings (2026-07-10 06:46)

+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/MLXLanguageModel.swift:2353` — Both branches of the conditional return the same unchanged `messages` value; the guard-else structure produces verbatim duplicate returns. Simplify to remove the guard-else structure and just return `messages` directly. If this structure is intentionally preserved as a documented seam for future schema-in-prompt rendering (per the comment), make that intent explicit in the docstring rather than preserving dead code with duplicate returns. Currently the guard statement and its condition add no runtime value since both branches are identical.
+- [ ] `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/GuidedGenerationSchemaPromptTests.swift:41` — Duplicates ContextSizeGenerationProbeModel from ContextSizeValidationTests.swift. This reinvents a test utility that already exists and could be parameterized to avoid duplication. Extract a parameterized probe model factory or base class that both test files can reuse, accepting the error type as a parameter. For example: create a generic `GenerationProbeModel<ErrorType>` or a factory function `makeGenerationProbeModel(throwing:)` in a shared test utility.
+
+## Review Findings (2026-07-10 07:36)
+
+- [ ] `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/ContextSizeValidationTests.swift:129` — ContextSizeThinkThenCallByteTokenizer is a near-match to EagerFallbackByteFallbackTokenizer that could have been extended with a promptText parameter rather than reimplemented, duplicating encode/decode/token-conversion logic across three test files. Generalize the byte-fallback tokenizer to accept an optional promptText parameter (defaulting to returning [] from applyChatTemplate), eliminating duplication across all three test files and creating a single source of truth for this test utility.
+- [ ] `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/EagerFallbackPrepareOrderingTests.swift:94` — EagerFallbackGenerationProbeModel reimplements probe model boilerplate with identical kvHeads and callAsFunction() logic that is duplicated across three test files, differing only in which error prepare() throws. Extract a parameterized GenericGenerationProbeModel that accepts an error to throw in prepare(), eliminating duplication of kvHeads and callAsFunction() across all three test files.
+- [ ] `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/ToolCallingImagePreservationTests.swift:67` — ToolCallingImageProbeGenerationModel reimplements probe model boilerplate identical to ContextSizeGenerationProbeModel and EagerFallbackGenerationProbeModel, duplicating kvHeads and callAsFunction() across three test files with only the error type differing. Refactor to a shared parameterized GenericGenerationProbeModel or base class that eliminates duplication of kvHeads and callAsFunction() logic across ContextSizeValidationTests.swift, EagerFallbackPrepareOrderingTests.swift, and ToolCallingImagePreservationTests.swift.
+- [ ] `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/ToolCallingImagePreservationTests.swift:128` — ToolCallingImagePreservationByteFallbackTokenizer reimplements byte-fallback tokenizer functionality with identical encode/decode/token-conversion logic that already exists in EagerFallbackByteFallbackTokenizer, duplicating test code across files. Extract the shared byte-fallback tokenizer to a common test utility that can be reused across ToolCallingImagePreservationTests.swift, EagerFallbackPrepareOrderingTests.swift, and ContextSizeValidationTests.swift instead of reimplementing it in each test file.
\ No newline at end of file
